description: One session's lease record as constructed by sync/lease/lifecycle/lifecycle.py at acquire and written by sync/lease/core/records.py (staged sibling + rename). Core fields are written at acquire; the stamped fields appear as applicable. S5 adds the venue key (plan §7 V1) — absent from every record at the pin. additionalProperties stays open: lifecycle stamps further fields on the paths the review names (extension, renewal, spend).

jobs.description: Job ids; the store persists the pruned live-jobs projection at every save.

renew.description: Window lease longer than one session life.

venue.description: The venue the lease belongs to (S5, plan §7 V1): stamped at write time by the extracted core, and on the legacy stock by the §10.3 one-time migration; no reader defaults it.

title: Lease record (var/lease-<session>.json)
